notes: `W2` (selector `[]`, same series as `W1`) is a proven superset of current `C` (selector `['src']`) too, and more recent than `W1` -- but its stored record is edited to `completeness.status: 'partial'` after the fact (simulating a crashed/interrupted re-run whose record survived). `previous-superset`'s series-mate scan pre-filters on `completeness.status === 'complete'` before candidacy is even considered (same discipline as `previous-comparable`/`git-ref`), so `W2` never becomes a candidate and the older, complete `W1` is the sole (and therefore trivially maximal) candidate -- no `baseline.superset_candidates` disclosure. `tests/t.test.ts` (red in `W1`) is outside `C`'s narrower selector and is disclosed via `transitions.out_of_scope`, confirming `W1`, not the excluded `W2`, was selected.
